method: Three fresh reviewers a round, each given only the ten blind sheets (docs/c22-9/blind/<sheet>.jpg) and the cards' level descriptions, put each sheet's letters A to E in level order (each level once) and named the least convincing thing on each sheet. Rule (wear_check_c22.py): a reviewer passes a sheet with all five right or one swap of neighbouring levels; a sheet passes when at least three reviewers do. Each round's reviewers were new; the rounds' renders differ (the fixes between them are in docs/c22-9).

least_real.topsides: The waterline 'clay mustache' on B and C is a regular row of evenly spaced, identically sized brown blobs, like a repeated stamp, not a continuous scum band. B and C are almost indistinguishable, and the L3 'spider cracks' and yellowing are not visible at all.
least_real.bottom: C's keel rust is a uniform orange leopard-spot noise pasted evenly over the whole blade, with no runs, blisters or edge concentration. The hull's green slime is a flat tint, and the brown fouling along the top edge repeats the same blob pattern as the topsides.
least_real.deck: E's mildew is large soft cloudy blotches of tiling noise spread evenly over the flat cabin top as well as the walkways, like a dirty camo overlay. Nothing follows the traffic paths or drainage, and A, B and D are nearly identical.
least_real.teak: The L4 drop boards (A) are a flat black-grey mottle with no grain or checks. On A and D the cockpit coaming has vertical streaks that look like a stretched, smeared texture (curtain-like fringes), not water streaks.
least_real.canvas: A's dirt is fine vertical dark pinstripes, perfectly even across the panel, like a brushed-metal texture. The L0-L3 variants differ only in a barely perceptible tint shift.
least_real.liner: C's speckled grey noise over the whole headliner and liner reads as a sandpaper texture, not mildew. The black mildew spots dumped on the sole by the post are uniform dark flecks with no relation to where water would sit.
least_real.headliner: B's mildew on the bulkhead panel is a hard-edged rectangle of grey camo noise. The leak stains in B and D are pale, hard-edged blotches pasted across the white mouldings, not stains spreading from the windows and fittings. A, C and E barely differ.
least_real.sole: On E the grey-black mildew is a hard-edged smudge that clips abruptly at the post and the mat edge. The holly strips stay perfectly crisp and parallel through it, so it looks like a decal over the floor, not wear in the wood.
least_real.joinery: The veneer is a flat, grainless orange-brown plane on every level, so L0, L1 and L3 differ only by hue. C's 'grey and dry' state reads as a desaturated filter, not weathered wood. The cushions' dirt is a large blurry cloud pattern.
least_real.cushions: The plaid is a soft blurry checker at almost no visible scale, with no weave. D's stains are the same speckle as the sole's mildew, scattered at the floor edge. A's 'stains' are diffuse clouds of tiling noise across the whole seat, not marks at the seat fronts.
